_what: Settings of the large-file road (read-data/whole-file.mjs LARGE_FILE, read-data/raw-pieces.mjs RAW_PIECES): a file above `threshold_bytes` is kept as one of the person's files in raw pieces of `piece_bytes` (raw-pieces.mjs keepInRawPieces: each piece the body of one octet-stream POST with its call in X-Call, which the engine hands to tool:your-files as the piece's content_file), instead of 40 KiB base64 pieces. `piece_bytes` is the engine's own most bytes for one raw body (the engine's src/mcp/settings.json upload_most_bytes, 32 MiB). A piece whose outcome is unknown, or a busy or throttled door, is asked again after `first_wait_ms` doubled each time, at most `most_tries` times in a row; the upload goes on from where write_file_start says it stands.
